name: pg_privileges_inconsistent_quoting_role
subject: Fix inconsistent quoting of role names in ACLs.
goal:
ACL item output and input disagree for role names containing a double quote, and an empty quoted name around the grantor separator can be misparsed as a quote character.

Create a role named like `regress_"quoted`, build an aclitem with makeaclitem(), and round-trip its textual form. Both grantee and grantor must be emitted with SQL-style doubled quotes and parse back identically. An aclitem such as `""=r*/""` must be rejected because no grantor name follows the slash. Simple, whitespace-containing and PUBLIC ACL names must keep their established syntax.
